title: Vertical Metal Band Saws with Blade Welder — 12″ to 23″ Throat | NovoTech
meta_description: Value-line vertical metal band saws VS-300 to VS-585: 12″ to 23″ throat, tilting table, inverter blade speed and a built-in blade welder for contour and internal cuts. Specs in inches, sold and supported in Canada.
intro: Vertical band saws for the tool room, fabrication and maintenance shop: the blade runs vertically and the workpiece — sheet, plate, bar, profiles, plastics or wood — is pushed across the table, so the saw cuts contours, radii, slots and straight lines that a horizontal saw cannot. The VS series has four sizes from a 12-1/4″ to a 23″ throat, a table that tilts 45° right (30° on the two larger saws) and 15° left, stepless blade speed from an inverter, and a blade welder with annealer and grinder on the column: cut the blade, thread it through a drilled hole, weld it and saw an internal cut-out. For slicing blocks and plate on a production line see the premium vertical saws. If you are looking for a vertical band saw for metal cutting or a vertical bandsaw for plate, blocks and contour work, these are the machines NovoTech sells and supports in Canada.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoTech vertical band saws

faq.q: What is the throat of a vertical band saw?
faq.a: The width from the blade to the column (how wide a part can pass beside the blade) and the height under the upper blade guide (how thick a part can be). The VS-300 takes 12-1/4″ × 7-1/4″ (310 × 185 mm), the VS-400 15-3/4″ × 11-1/4″, the VS-500 19-3/4″ × 12-1/4″ and the VS-585 23″ × 13-1/4″ (585 × 336 mm).

faq.q: What is the blade welder for?
faq.a: Internal cut-outs and blade repair. Drill a hole in the part, cut the blade, thread it through the hole and weld it on the saw's own butt welder, anneal the weld and grind it flush with the built-in grinder — then saw the inside contour. The same welder makes blades from coil stock and repairs a broken blade in a few minutes.

Yes — mild steel, stainless, tool steel in thin sections, aluminum, copper and brass, as well as plastics and wood: the inverter sets the blade speed from about 33 – 49 ft/min for steel to 590 – 1,076 ft/min for aluminum and non-metals. The chart on the saw gives the speed and tooth pitch for each material and thickness.

faq.q: Vertical band saw or horizontal band saw?
faq.a: A horizontal saw clamps a bar and cuts it to length, unattended; a vertical saw is a hand-fed machine for shapes — curves, slots, angles, notches and internal cut-outs in sheet and plate. Most shops that cut both have one of each.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
